scope: Universal remains only: fresh = ambiguous bones with flesh; old = bare bones. No species-specific anatomy.

bones.name: Перекрещенные
bones.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One UNIVERSAL battlefield remains marker for a low-resolution pixel-art tactical dungeon game. This is a generic little pile of bones that could belong to EITHER a human OR a monster: deliberately anatomically ambiguous. NO skull, NO head, NO face, NO teeth, NO hands or feet, NO claws, NO horns, NO animal anatomy, NO recognisable complete skeleton, NO armor, NO weapons, NO clothing.
Render as genuine simple low-resolution sprite art with roughly 48x28 logical pixels in the occupied object, magnified with crisp blocky square pixels. Compact horizontal footprint, low on the ground, shallow 3/4 overhead view appropriate to a 2:1 isometric floor. Simple thick interconnected color clusters, 8-10 colors only, muted dirty ivory bone surfaces, warm taupe shadows, desaturated gray-purple deep shade, localized dark outline. Light from top left. Every bone is a chunky anonymous short long-bone fragment or unidentifiable flat bone piece. Never delicate anatomical detail.
Transparent RGBA background, object fully isolated with generous clear margins. No ground tile, no painted background, no gradient halo or blurred shadow. At most a thin hard pixel contact edge touching the bones. No lettering, borders, labels, interface. No smooth illustration, no antialiasing, no blur, no 3D render. Variant 1: three thick, short anonymous broken bones lying loosely across each other in a shallow asymmetric criss-cross, with one small irregular flat fragment tucked at their intersection. Sparse open readable shape. Dry bare bones only, no meat or blood.

fresh_edit: Preserve the exact arrangement, silhouette, pixel grid, palette and camera of these universal bone fragments. Add small simple patches of dark muted burgundy and brown-red meat clinging to and around the bone fragments, with bone ends still visible. It must read as fresh remains containing bones and flesh. Restrained stylized low-detail pixel art, not realistic viscera. No head, skull, face, organs, complete body, limbs, clothing, equipment, species traits, blood pool, floor or background. True transparent RGBA. Keep chunky hard pixel clusters and no smoothing.
